description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]; not covered by the free trial). [Fetch and read the web] Batch URL to Markdown web scraper for RAG ingest and research agents. page-markdown for 1-5 public URLs in one paid call (comma-separated): the same clean main-content Markdown, metadata and options (include_links, max_tokens) per URL, with a per-URL error (robots_disallowed, target_http_error...) where a page cannot be read. If every URL fails, nothing is charged. One payment for 5 URLs = $0.002 per URL, the same as 5 single page-markdown calls; for 1-4 URLs single calls ($0.002 each) are cheaper. robots.txt checked per URL and redirect. ~2-10 s.

include_links.description: false = drop link targets and images, keep the text (default true)

max_tokens.description: Cut the Markdown to about this many tokens at block boundaries (100-100000); sets truncated and truncated_reason "max_tokens"

name: page_markdown_batch

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.
